title: FIIs Bought ₹60,698 Cr in 7 Days — India Bull Market? #Shorts
description:
FIIs dumped ₹3.82 lakh crore. Now they want it back.

₹60,698 crore bought in just 7 sessions — the biggest FII rush since January 2021. Nifty profits +22.3% YoY. P/E at 18x, below the 5-year average of 20.8x.

Is India's bull market back, or is this a head fake?
